name: Mantle of Love
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 2, paladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a heart-shaped ruby worth 50 gp)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You imbue the target creature with the protective love of your deity, protecting him from harm by granting him a +4 morale bonus on all saving throws. The spell ends if you and the target move out of sight of one another.
